subject: CFDate/CFData/CFURL toll-free bridges

observation.summary: Single runtime probe verifies three more toll-free bridges by constructing NSData, NSDate, NSURL and casting them to CFTypeRef. CFGetTypeID() returns 20 (CFData), 42 (CFDate), and 29 (CFURL) — each matched against CFDataGetTypeID/CFDateGetTypeID/CFURLGetTypeID() respectively.
observation.raw_output_excerpt:
NSDate   -> CFDate:   ns=0xaae88ee232d3cc89 cf=OK (id match? expected=42 got=42)
NSData   -> CFData:   ns=0x10102d4e0     cf=OK (id match? expected=20 got=20)
NSURL    -> CFURL:    ns=0x10102d650     cf=OK (id match? expected=29 got=29)

claim: On this host CFDateRef, CFDataRef, and CFURLRef are each identity-preserved with their NSDate, NSData, and NSURL counterparts and report matching CFTypeIDs (42, 20, 29 respectively); these three additional toll-free bridges are observed and confirmed.
